name: near_drone
description: WARNING NEAR: fresh aircraft within 1 km and 150 m of a live drone; 1.1 km and 350 m above do not count.
worked_example: Drone D9A03 at alt_geo 150 m; UAL123 is 480 m E and 640 m N of it at alt_geom 240 m.
horiz = sqrt(480^2 + 640^2) = 800.0 m <= 1000; vert = 240 - 150 = +90.0 m, |90| <= 150 -> TRAFFIC NEAR DRONE D9A03 (bearing 36.9 deg from the drone).
Resolution: the aircraft is 90 m above (more than 30 m) -> give way by descending: 'GIVE WAY: DESCEND AND LAND D9A03; AIRCRAFT 90 M ABOVE, 800 M NE'.
N12345: 1100 m W -> beyond 1000 m, nothing. SKW55: 700 m S but alt 500 -> vert +350 > 150, nothing.

Also LOW (UAS airspace: airborne, within 3 km of the observer or a live drone, below 460 m above ground; ground = the observer's elevation 20 m): b2c3d4 at t=0 'LOW TRAFFIC W 1.1 KM' ('BE READY TO LAND DRONES; AIRCRAFT 180 M ABOVE GROUND, 1.1 KM W'). A warning for the same aircraft supersedes its LOW, which shows again once the warning clears.

expect.summary: conflict watch on, 1 low aircraft, 1 ADS-B conflict, data 4 s old
